name: H&R GmbH & Co. KGaA
summary: H&R GmbH & Co. KGaA engages in the production and sale of chemical-pharmaceutical raw materials and injection molded precision plastic parts worldwide. It operates through three segments: ChemPharm Refining, ChemPharm Sales, and Plastics. The ChemPharm Refining segment offers paraffins, white oils, plasticizers, base oils, lubricants, and other crude-oil based specialty products, as well as bitumen, feedstocks, and bunker fuel. The ChemPharm Sales segment provides paraffins, plasticizers, wax emulsions, and other crude-oil based specialty products.
